import json,collections

c=collections.Counter(v for r in a for v in r['slots'].values())
print('Count, order, slot coverage verified.')
print('Items:',len(a),'Calls:',dict(c),'Unmarked items:',sum(bool(r['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for r in a))
